description: This Java class, `AdbMessage`, encapsulates the structure and behavior of an Android Debug Bridge (ADB) command packet. It provides methods for setting command headers, managing message data, and performing read/write operations over USB using `UsbRequest`. The class defines ADB command constants, handles checksum calculations, and formats messages for communication with Android devices.

classes.name: AdbMessage
classes.description: Encapsulates an ADB command packet for communication with Android devices over USB. Provides methods to set and get message fields, perform checksum calculations, and facilitate USB read/write operations.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the fields in the command header, including command, arguments, and optional data payload.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the command identifier from the message.

methods.name: getArg0
methods.description: Retrieves the first argument of the command.

methods.name: getArg1
methods.description: Retrieves the second argument of the command.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the ByteBuffer containing the data payload.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the data payload.

methods.name: getDataString
methods.description: Converts the data payload to a string, trimming trailing zero.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends the message over USB to the connected device, queuing the command and data requests.

methods.name: readCommand
methods.description: Queues a request to read a command message from USB.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Queues a request to read data payload from USB.
